QuestInfo.name: Octopuses Do Your Body Good
QuestInfo.0: Something still seems to be wrong with Lady Syl. Go see #bRyden#k.
QuestInfo.1: Gather the necessary ingredients to make a special tonic that will energize Lady Syl. #bGo to the Construction Site using the portal located to the right of Kerning City#k and gather some Octopus Legs.
QuestInfo.2: You hope that Lady Syl will get better soon. Go find out from Ryden if there is anything else you can do.

0.0: #h0#! Have you heard the rumor already? All of the Stirges were eliminated, but Lady Syl is still not able to sleep. I think it's because she's grown so weak. We should prepare a tonic for her.

yes.0: There is an old recipe for a tonic that's been used for generations by the people of Kerning City. It's a tonic made by boiling octopus legs. It's been said that this tonic, made by boiling octopus legs for three straight days and nights, can even make a dead person come to life!
yes.1: Please bring me #b10 Octopus Legs#k, so that I can make her a tonic. Go to the Construction Site to the right and you'll be able to find a bunch of Octopuses.

no.0: If Lady Syl becomes ill, all of our efforts will be for naught!

1.0: You've collected the Octopus Legs already? Please give them to me.

yes.0: Wow, I've never seen such fresh Octopus Legs! Now, all I have to do is to boil them for 3 days and 3 nights. Remember, the most important thing in making tonics is using fresh ingredients and putting a lot of care into it!

item.0: There should be a lot of #rOctopuses#k at the Construction Site to your right. Go get me #b10 Octopus Legs#k.
